movie.title: Islands
movie.overview: Amparo, alone and destitute, with her acting career over, has decided to take her own life at the very hotel where she once filmed one of her forgotten movies. She hopes the press will at least take note of her desperate end. But she crosses paths with Toni, a twenty-year-old man as tormented as she is. Over the course of two days, they will discover one another and realize that neither is quite what they seem. They harbor dark secrets that gradually come to light amidst bored tourists, decadent parties, and tense silences. Little do they imagine that the conclusion of this strange bond between them will prove to be as unsettling as it is unexpected.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An washed-up actress planning to end her life at a former film location forms an unexpected, unsettling bond with a troubled young man.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Destitute and forgotten, former actress Amparo checks into the hotel where she once made a movie, intending to commit suicide in hopes of regaining media attention. Her plan is derailed when she crosses paths with Toni, a tormented twenty-year-old wrestling with his own inner demons. Over two days spent among bored tourists and decadent parties, the pair forge a strange connection that gradually uncovers their darkest secrets. Ultimately, their brief time together leads to a shocking conclusion that neither could have anticipated.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Amparo is a destitute former actress whose career has long since faded into obscurity. Driven by desperation and isolation, she decides to take her own life at the very hotel where she once filmed one of her forgotten movies, hoping her tragic death will reignite public interest in her story. However, her fatalistic plan takes an unexpected turn when she meets Toni, a tormented twenty-year-old man battling deep emotional turmoil of his own. Set against the surreal backdrop of bored resort tourists, lavish parties, and heavy silences, the two spend two transformative days together. As they navigate their burgeoning bond, both Amparo and Toni begin to realize that neither is who they initially appeared to be. Dark secrets from their pasts slowly come to light, altering the dynamic of their relationship and forcing them to confront their shared isolation. What begins as a chance encounter between two lost souls rapidly evolves into an intense, psychologically complex connection. By the end of their brief journey, the collision of their hidden lives culminates in an unsettling twist that forever alters their fates.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Amparo, a destitute former actress facing the end of her career and life, retreats to a resort hotel—the site of one of her long-forgotten film shoots—intending to commit suicide as a final plea for public recognition. Her deliberate path to self-destruction is interrupted when she crosses paths with Toni, a troubled twenty-year-old man carrying his own heavy emotional burdens. Over the span of two days, set against the backdrop of a decadent resort filled with indifferent tourists and tense, quiet moments, the unlikely pair forge an intense and unpredictable bond. As they open up to one another, dark secrets emerge that shatter their initial impressions, building toward a deeply unsettling and surprising conclusion.
